summary.text: Suzanne Schmidt represents the 4th District, which includes Spokane Valley, Liberty Lake and Millwood, in the Washington House of Representatives. Her official page lists her as Ranking Member of the Labor & Workplace Standards Committee and Assistant Ranking Member of the Transportation Committee.

paragraphs.text: Schmidt grew up in Libby, Montana, where her father owned a small business, according to her official page.
It says she put herself through college as a single mother of two sons, worked as a park ranger at Libby Dam, and then took a permanent job with the Corps of Engineers at Libby Dam.
The page says that since 1999 she has represented Washington employers in workers' compensation claims management, Labor and Industries account management and safety consulting.
It says she was appointed President/CEO of the Associated Builders and Contractors Inland Pacific Chapter in 2016.
